title: ETL Rule Config
description: Configuration for ETL test data generation — defines source-to-target field mappings and transformations.

case_name.description: Unique identifier for this test case

source_format.description: Format of the source data file

source_fields.description: Ordered list of source column names

target_fields.description: Ordered list of all target/output column names

fixed_values.description: Target fields with constant values: {field: value}

source_field.description: Source field name (optional, also appears in config)

transformation_type.description: Type of transformation. Built-in: fixed, direct, empty, name_parser, conditional_map, split_extract, substring, phone_parser, composite. Custom types can be registered via custom_transformers.

transformation_rules.description: List of transformation rules to apply

unresolved_rules.description: Rules that could not be auto-resolved by rule_parser.py. Present only in draft configs — agent must resolve these and move them to transformation_rules before execution.

field_metadata.description: Metadata hints for source data generation

conditional_coverage.description: Fields requiring all values covered in test data generation. Use array format: {field: [value1, value2, ...]}. This is for DATA GENERATION coverage, NOT for defining transformation mappings.

record_count.description: Number of test records to generate

output_metadata.description: Metadata included in expected output file header
